stem.en: Engine A is more powerful than engine B. Both lift the same load to the same height. What can you say?

text.en: A does the same work as B, but in less time.
A does more work than B on the same load.
A does less work than B, because it is faster.
A and B take the same time, because the job is the same.

explanation.en: The work done is the load's weight x the height, the same for both engines. Power is work per second. A more powerful engine does the same work in less time. Power tells you how fast the work is done, not how much.

hints.en: Does the work depend on which engine does it?
